chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Yaḥyā ibn ʿAbbād al-Makkī has been transmitted by me from Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Asadī al-Kūfī, from Mūsā ibn ʿImrān al-Nakhaʿī, from his uncle al-Ḥusayn ibn Yazīd, from Yaḥyā ibn ʿAbbād al-Makkī.

key_terms.النَّخَعِيِّ: Nakhaʿī; indicating tribal or regional affiliation
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a formal expression of hadith transmission
key_terms.عَمِّهِ: His uncle; a relational term within the sanad/isnad

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Yaḥyā ibn ʿAbbād al-Makkī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Yaḥyā ibn ʿAbbād al-Makkī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission for hadith preservation and source verification within Shia hadith scholarship.
